home.title: Home
home.routingDescription: Full-document SSR, streaming, server functions with type-safe file-based routing
home.contractsDescription: Zod schemas, REST resources, optional oRPC tooling, and i18n locales from @repo/*
home.uiDescription: Headless Base UI primitives with the shadcn base-nova preset and Tailwind 4
home.wiredTitle: Everything is wired for your next product
home.wiredDescription: A production-minded foundation with clear module boundaries, shared contracts, and operational building blocks.
home.startTitle: Start a new project with confidence
home.startDescription: Follow the same repeatable path for every business capability.
home.flowTitle: From UI to durable domain behavior
home.flowDescription: Every request follows an explicit, testable boundary.
home.referencesDescription: Jump straight to the documentation for each tool in this foundation.
home.patternTitle: The pattern: modular monolith + layered CQRS
home.patternDescription: One deployable application with strong internal boundaries, independent domain modules, and a predictable request path.
home.patternModular: Modular monolith: modules share one runtime and database connection, but communicate through public use cases and events instead of internal tables.
home.patternLayers: Layered design: presentation stays thin; application commands and queries orchestrate; domain entities enforce invariants; infrastructure adapts databases and providers.
home.patternRuntime: Production behavior: REST remains the compatibility transport, shared Zod/oRPC contracts keep shapes aligned, and outbox events make critical side effects reliable.
home.folderDescription: The layout makes ownership obvious and gives every new module the same safe starting point.

hero.title: Enterprise Modular Monolith
hero.subtitle: A high-performance TypeScript architecture combining CQRS Lite, contract-first oRPC + REST, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA), transactional outbox events, and zero-trust multi-tenancy.

decisions.title: Why We Built It This Way: Technical Decision Matrix
decisions.subtitle: Every pattern was deliberately chosen to maximize developer velocity, operational resilience, and maintainability for both humans and AI coding agents.

layers.title: Explore the 4 Layers & Monorepo Packages
layers.subtitle: Strict inward dependency flow keeps business logic pure and fully decoupled from databases, HTTP frameworks, and client applications.

lifecycle.title: API Flow Trace: What Happens on GET & POST
lifecycle.subtitle: Detailed chronological walkthrough showing every file, guard, invariant, transaction, and background relay touched during incoming requests.
lifecycle.getSubtitle: Read Request Lifecycle: Fastify Routing -> Guards -> CQRS Query -> Cache -> Drizzle DB Read -> JSON Response
lifecycle.postSubtitle: Mutation Request Lifecycle: Fastify Routing -> FGA Guards -> Zod Validation -> CQRS Command -> Domain Invariants -> DB + Outbox Unit of Work -> Relay Worker -> Realtime Broadcast

services.title: Local Services, Ports & Observability Matrix
services.subtitle: Everything required for development is wired out-of-the-box via Docker Compose with zero cloud dependencies.

structure.title: Directory Tree & Layer Boundary Rules
structure.subtitle: A scalable monorepo layout where domain boundaries are strictly enforced at build and lint time.

tooling.title: Developer Workflow & CLI Generators
tooling.subtitle: Pre-wired tooling for bootstrapping, scaffolding features, running architecture checks, and executing tests.

techStack.title: Curated Modern Tech Stack
techStack.subtitle: Battle-tested libraries and frameworks powering our frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
